verdict.rationale: Teams docs describe building bots/agents and using Graph API/webhooks/connectors to automate Teams scenarios (posting messages, running tasks) outside the normal chat UI, which implies background automation potential, but there is no direct documentation of autonomous, self-triggering agent workflows running persistently in the background (e.g., scheduled or event-driven agent loops) — it's framed mainly as developer-built bots/connectors that still require external hosting/triggers. missing for 10: explicit autonomous/background scheduling capability, first-party 'run without user interaction' agent examples, independent confirmation of such automations working in production.
